tagline: Deploy logs and site status for collaborators — deploys stay behind the firewall.
requirements: Requires Node.js 22 or newer. Authenticate on the host, or set NETLIFY_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN. The --verbose flag exposes individual operation tools so they can be filtered separately.

tools.name: netlify-observability-get-request-logs
tools.note: Reads request logs, which can contain private data.

seo.description: Share Netlify MCP inspection tools with MCPWire. Expose individual operations, configure host authentication, and keep deployment tools blocked.
